title: Programming-by-Example for Batch-Editing Collision Meshes in 3D Software
abstract: arXiv:2607.08804v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As 3D software proliferates, software artifacts now extend beyond code and 2D user interfaces to include 3D assets. Among these assets, collision meshes are critical as they define the geometry used by physics engines for collision detection and physical interaction. Although existing tools can automatically generate collision meshes from visual meshes, they often fail to capture the intended interaction behavior. As a result, developers need to manually edit many heterogeneous collision meshes, a process that is time-consuming and challenging to scale.   To address this problem, we present a neuro-symbolic program synthesis approach for batch-editing collision meshes. We formulate the task as a programming-by-example problem: given a family of collision meshes with the same editing intent and a small number of user demonstrations, our approach synthesizes a reusable program that captures the editing intent and applies it to non-demons

translated_title: 三维软件中基于示例编程的碰撞网格批量编辑方法
translated_abstract: 随着3D软件的普及，软件制品已不仅限于代码和2D用户界面，还扩展到了3D资产。在这些资产中，碰撞网格至关重要，因为它们定义了物理引擎用于碰撞检测和物理交互的几何体。尽管现有工具可以从视觉网格自动生成碰撞网格，但它们往往无法捕捉预期的交互行为。因此，开发人员需要手动编辑大量异构的碰撞网格，这一过程既耗时又难以扩展。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种用于批量编辑碰撞网格的神经符号程序合成方法。我们将该任务表述为基于示例的编程问题：给定一组具有相同编辑意图的碰撞网格和少量用户演示，我们的方法能够合成一个可重用的程序，该程序捕捉编辑意图并将其应用于非演示样本。
tldr: 本文提出一种神经符号程序合成方法，将碰撞网格批量编辑建模为基于示例的编程问题，通过少量用户演示合成可重用程序，从而高效捕捉并批量应用编辑意图。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic program synthesis approach that formulates batch-editing of collision meshes as a programming-by-example problem, synthesizing reusable programs from a few user demonstrations to efficiently capture and apply editing intents at scale.
